The clinician sent a serum quantitative hCG the same day because the last menstrual period was uncertain (R06cd97926d25); that specimen was collected before the evaluation time and the result Ra59404643b34 is still registered with no final result, so pregnancy status - and therefore treatment adequacy - cannot be determined.
